title: Accurate Identification of ADHD among Adults Using Real-Time Activity Data
summary: The study reports 98.43% accuracy, 98.33% sensitivity and 98.56% specificity on its study dataset. Validation is cross-validation on the same dataset; external replication and clinical utility are not established.
ai_technology: PCA-selected real-time activity features feed six classifiers, with SVM selected using 10-fold cross-validation to distinguish adult ADHD status.
organization: Department of Computer Engineering and Technology, Guru Nanak Dev University, Amritsar, India
